_comment: Single source of truth for the build matrix. One entry per ISC-supported Kea branch.
Adding or retiring a branch is an edit here only - never in a workflow.
kea          full upstream version; upstream git tag is Kea-<kea>
alpine       Alpine release line, for humans
alpineRef    what the Dockerfile actually pins - multi-arch index digest
lts          marks the branch that also gets the -lts moving tag
images       image suffixes built for this branch; published as kea-<suffix>
3.0 ships kea-ctrl-agent; it was removed upstream in 3.2 once the daemons
gained native HTTP/TLS control sockets. Hence a per-branch image list.
